DNW_S_8 {
    @ Space between ((PW INSIDE DNW) NOT INTERACT DG) and (PW NOT INTERACT DG) at different nets (except the LDBK region).
    @ This rule purpose is defined for different potential application.>= 1um
    X = (PW INSIDE DNW) NOT INTERACT DG
    Y = PW NOT INTERACT DG
    ((EXT X Y < 1.0 ABUT<90 SINGULAR REGION NOT CONNECTED) NOT INSIDE EXCLU)NOT INSIDE LDBK
}

AA_W_2b {
    @ Channel width for 2.5V NMOS/PMOS transistors, including GT_25UD18, GT_25OD33 and GT_25DD50. (except the INST region).>= 0.21um
    X = GT INSIDE EDGE ((AA AND DG) AND(OR UNDEPL OVERPL MOSOV5))
    Y1 = LENGTH X < 0.21
    Y2 = LENGTH GATE_D_W < 0.21
    ((EXPAND EDGE Y1 INSIDE BY 0.001) NOT INSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    ((EXPAND EDGE Y2 INSIDE BY 0.001) NOT INSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

AA_S_3a {
    @ Space between two AAs in the same well (including NW, PW, DNW, VTNH, VTPH, LVN, LVP). DRC waive check 45-degree spaces(1degree tolerance) in the INDMY region. DRC waive check the INST region.>= 0.1um
    Y = OR NW DNW VTNH VTPH LVN LVP PW
    ((((EXT AA < 0.10 ABUT<90 SINGULAR REGION) INSIDE Y) NOT INDMY) NOT INSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    ((((EXT AA < 0.10 ABUT<44 SINGULAR REGION) INSIDE Y) AND INDMY) NOT INSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    ((((EXT AA < 0.10 ABUT>46<90 SINGULAR REGION) INSIDE Y) AND INDMY) NOT INSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

AA_D_10a_Min {
    @ Local AA density (including dummy AA) in 200umX200um window with step size 100um>= 0.19
    @ <= 0.9
    Check_region = DRC:1 NOT EXCLUi
    Check_pattern = (AA_all NOT EXCLUi) AND Check_region
    CHIP_wilayer = BULK INTERACT Check_pattern
    Check_window1 = Check_region with width >= 200.0/4
    err1_TMP1 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window1 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window1))+(!AREA(Check_window1)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.19 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER DRC:1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window2 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP1) with width >= 200.0/4
    err1_TMP2 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window2 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window2))+(!AREA(Check_window2)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.19 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window3 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP2) with width >= 200.0/4
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window3 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window3))+(!AREA(Check_window3)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.19 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP2 BY POLYGON
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10a_Min.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10a_Min.rdb"
}

AA_D_10a_Max {
    @ Local AA density (including dummy AA) in 200umX200um window with step size 100um>= 0.19
    @ <= 0.9
    Check_region = DRC:1 NOT EXCLUi
    Check_pattern = (AA_all NOT EXCLUi) AND Check_region
    Check_window1 = Check_region with width >= 200.0/4
    err1_TMP1 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window1 Check_region [!!AREA(Check_window1)*AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)-(~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window1)))] > 0.9 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER DRC:1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window2 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP1) with width >= 200.0/4
    err1_TMP2 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window2 Check_region [!!AREA(Check_window2)*AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)-(~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window2)))] > 0.9 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window3 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP2) with width >= 200.0/4
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window3 Check_region [!!AREA(Check_window3)*AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)-(~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window3)))] > 0.9 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP2 BY POLYGON
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10a_Max.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10a_Max.rdb"
}

AA_D_10a1_Min {
    @ Local AA density (including dummy AA) in 150umX150um window with step size 50um>= 0.19
    @ <= 0.8
    Check_region = DRC:1 NOT EXCLUi
    Check_pattern = (AA_all NOT EXCLUi) AND Check_region
    CHIP_wilayer = BULK INTERACT Check_pattern
    Check_window1 = Check_region with width >= 150.0/4
    err1_TMP1 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window1 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(150.0*150.0/4-AREA(Check_window1))+(!AREA(Check_window1)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.19 WINDOW 150.0 STEP 50.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER DRC:1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window2 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP1) with width >= 150.0/4
    err1_TMP2 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window2 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(150.0*150.0/4-AREA(Check_window2))+(!AREA(Check_window2)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.19 WINDOW 150.0 STEP 50.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window3 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP2) with width >= 150.0/4
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window3 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(150.0*150.0/4-AREA(Check_window3))+(!AREA(Check_window3)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.19 WINDOW 150.0 STEP 50.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP2 BY POLYGON
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10a1_Min.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10a1_Min.rdb"
}

AA_D_10a1_Max {
    @ Local AA density (including dummy AA) in 150umX150um window with step size 50um>= 0.19
    @ <= 0.8
    Check_region = DRC:1 NOT EXCLUi
    Check_pattern = (AA_all NOT EXCLUi) AND Check_region
    Check_window1 = Check_region with width >= 150.0/4
    err1_TMP1 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window1 Check_region [!!AREA(Check_window1)*AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)-(~~(150.0*150.0/4-AREA(Check_window1)))] > 0.8 WINDOW 150.0 STEP 50.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER DRC:1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window2 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP1) with width >= 150.0/4
    err1_TMP2 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window2 Check_region [!!AREA(Check_window2)*AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)-(~~(150.0*150.0/4-AREA(Check_window2)))] > 0.8 WINDOW 150.0 STEP 50.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window3 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP2) with width >= 150.0/4
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window3 Check_region [!!AREA(Check_window3)*AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)-(~~(150.0*150.0/4-AREA(Check_window3)))] > 0.8 WINDOW 150.0 STEP 50.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP2 BY POLYGON
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10a1_Max.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10a1_Max.rdb"
}

AA_D_10b_Min {
    @ Global AA density for fully chip (including dummy AA)>= 0.23
    @ <= 0.75
    Check_region = DRC:1 NOT EXCLUi
    Check_pattern = (AA_all NOT EXCLUi) AND Check_region
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_region [(!AREA(Check_pattern)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region))] < 0.23
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10b_Min.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10b_Min.rdb"
}

AA_D_10b_Max {
    @ Global AA density for fully chip (including dummy AA)>= 0.23
    @ <= 0.75
    Check_region = DRC:1 NOT EXCLUi
    Check_pattern = (AA_all NOT EXCLUi) AND Check_region
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_region [!!AREA(Check_pattern)*(AREA(Check_pattern))/AREA(Check_region)] > 0.75
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10b_Max.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10b_Max.rdb"
}

AA_D_10c_R {
    @ AA density inside of dummy block area (DUMBA OR NODMF),while the area of dummy block layer is larger than 2500um2 (50umX50um)>= 0.23
    X = AREA (DUMBA OR NODMF) > 2500
    Check_region = X NOT EXCLUi
    Check_pattern = (AA_all NOT EXCLUi) AND Check_region
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_region [(!AREA(Check_pattern)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region))] < 0.23
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10c_R.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_AA_D_10c_R.rdb"
}

AA_L_16_R {
    @ Maximum AA length between two contacts, or between one contact and AA line end when AA width < 0.15 Âµm<= 25um
    AA_CHECK = WITH WIDTH AA < 0.15
    Z0 = SIZE CT BY 12.5 INSIDE OF AA_CHECK STEP 0.02
    Z1 = Z0 INTERACT CT < 2
    Z2 = (AA_CHECK INTERACT Z1) NOT (AA_CHECK INTERACT CT == 1)
    Z2 NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    X = CONVEX EDGE AA ANGLE1>=89.9<=90.1 ANGLE2>=89.9<=90.1 WITH LENGTH<0.15
    Y = (AA WITH WIDTH <0.15) INTERACT CT
    Z = Y TOUCH EDGE X
    Z3 = SIZE CT BY 25 INSIDE OF Y STEP 0.02
    ((Z NOT INSIDE EDGE Z3) NOT TOUCH EDGE Z3) NOT INSIDE EDGE EXCLU
}

VTNH_O_3 {
@ VTNH overlap with PSUB, P+ active AA(exclude pick-up AA), VTPH, DG are not allowed.
  (AND VTNH PSUB) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND VTNH (PACT NOT PTAP)) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND VTNH VTPH) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND VTNH DG) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

VTNH_S_5 {
@ Space between VTNH and MOS AA of other device along other deviceâs GATE poly length direction, excluding SRAM region>= 0.12um
  X1 = NACT TOUCH EDGE (AA INSIDE EDGE GT)
  X2 = PACT TOUCH EDGE (AA INSIDE EDGE GT)
  X = X1 OR EDGE X2
  ((EXT X VTNH < 0.12 ABUT<90 REGION OPPOSITE) NOT INSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

VTPH_O_3 {
@ VTPH overlap with PSUB, N+ active AA(exclude pick-up AA), VTNH, DG are not allowed.
  (AND VTPH PSUB) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND VTPH (NACT NOT NTAP)) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND VTPH VTNH) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND VTPH DG) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

VTPH_S_5 {
@ Space between VTPH and MOS AA of other device along other deviceâs GATE poly length direction, excluding SRAM region>= 0.12um
  X1 = PACT TOUCH EDGE (AA INSIDE EDGE GT)
  X2 = NACT TOUCH EDGE (AA INSIDE EDGE GT)
  X = X1 OR EDGE X2
  ((EXT X VTPH < 0.12 ABUT<90 REGION OPPOSITE) NOT INSIDE INST)NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  }

LVN_O_3 {
@ LVN overlap with PSUB, P+ active AA(exclude pick-up AA), LVP, DG are not allowed
  (AND LVN PSUB) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND LVN (PACT NOT PTAP)) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND LVN LVP) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND LVN DG) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

LVN_S_5 {
@ Space between LVN and MOS AA of other device along other deviceâs GATE poly length direction.>= 0.12um
  X1 = NACT TOUCH EDGE (AA INSIDE EDGE GT)
  X2 = PACT TOUCH EDGE (AA INSIDE EDGE GT)
  X = X1 OR EDGE X2
  (EXT X LVN < 0.12 ABUT<90 REGION OPPOSITE) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

LVP_O_3 {
@ LVP overlap with PSUB, N+ active AA(exclude pick-up AA), LVN, DG are not allowed
  (AND LVP PSUB) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND LVP (NACT NOT (NTAP OR PTAP))) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND LVP LVN) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND LVP DG) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

LVP_S_5 {
@ Space between LVP and MOS AA of other device along other deviceâs GATE poly length direction.>= 0.12um
  X1 = PACT TOUCH EDGE (AA INSIDE EDGE GT)
  X2 = NACT TOUCH EDGE (AA INSIDE EDGE GT)
  X = X1 OR EDGE X2
  (EXT X LVP < 0.12 ABUT<90  REGION OPPOSITE) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

GT_L_1c {
    @ Channel length for 2.5V over drive to 3.3V NMOS/PMOS transistors (GT_25OD33), except the INST region>= 0.50(NMOS)um
    @ >= 0.40(PMOS)um
    X = GT INSIDE EDGE ((NACT AND DG) AND OVERPL)
    Y = GT INSIDE EDGE ((PACT AND DG) AND OVERPL)
    ((INT X < 0.50 ABUT<90 REGION) NOT INSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    ((INT Y < 0.40 ABUT<90 REGION) NOT INSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

GT_L_1e {
    @ Channel length for 2.5V drain drive to 5V NMOS/PMOS transistors (GT_25DD50), except the INST region>= 0.50(NMOS)um
    @ >= 0.45(PMOS)um
    X = GT INSIDE EDGE ((NACT AND DG) AND MOSOV5)
    Y = GT INSIDE EDGE ((PACT AND DG) AND MOSOV5)
    ((INT X < 0.50 ABUT<90 REGION) NOT INSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    ((INT Y < 0.45 ABUT<90 REGION) NOT INSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

GT_S_3b {
    @ Space between two GTs when one or both GT width is >= 0.4um, and the run length of two GTs is >= 0.5um.>= 0.16um
    GT_W = WITH WIDTH GT >= 0.4
    GT_S = EXT GT_W GT < 0.16 OPPOSITE REGION PARA ONLY
    GT_LS = LENGTH GT_S >= 0.5
    (GT_S WITH EDGE GT_LS) NOT INSIDE EDGE EXCLU
}

GT_S_3b1 {
    @ Space between two GTs when one or both GT width is >= 0.4um, and the run length of two GTs is >= 0.5um.>= 0.15um
    GT_W = WITH WIDTH GT >= 0.4
    GT_S = EXT GT_W GT < 0.15 OPPOSITE REGION PARA ONLY
    GT_LS = LENGTH GT_S >= 0.5
    (GT_S WITH EDGE GT_LS) NOT INSIDE EDGE EXCLU
}

GT_EX_6a_R {
    @ GT end-cap extension of AA when:
    @ 1.Â  GT space to L-shape AA in the same MOS is < 0.1um
    @ 2.Â  GATE channel width (W) is >= 0.15um
    @ DRC only check the L-shape opposite side GT end-cap.>= 0.16um
    A = ENC AA GT < 0.16 OPPOSITE REGION
    X = LENGTH GATE_W >= 0.15
    Y = GATE WITH EDGE X
    B = EXT [Y] AA < 0.1 ABUT==90 PERP ONLY
    (A WITH EDGE (A TOUCH EDGE B)) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

GT_D_7a_Min {
    @ Local GT density (including dummy) in 200um*200um window with step size: 100um.>= 0.07
    @ <= 0.7
    Check_region = DRC:1 NOT EXCLUi
    Check_pattern = (GT_all NOT EXCLUi) AND Check_region
    CHIP_wilayer = BULK INTERACT Check_pattern
    Check_window1 = Check_region with width >= 200.0/4
    err1_TMP1 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window1 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window1))+(!AREA(Check_window1)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.07 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER DRC:1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window2 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP1) with width >= 200.0/4
    err1_TMP2 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window2 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window2))+(!AREA(Check_window2)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.07 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window3 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP2) with width >= 200.0/4
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window3 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window3))+(!AREA(Check_window3)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.07 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP2 BY POLYGON
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_GT_D_7a_Min.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_GT_D_7a_Min.rdb"
}

GT_D_7a_Max {
    @ Local GT density (including dummy) in 200um*200um window with step size: 100um.>= 0.07
    @ <= 0.7
    Check_region = DRC:1 NOT EXCLUi
    Check_pattern = (GT_all NOT EXCLUi) AND Check_region
    Check_window1 = Check_region with width >= 200.0/4
    err1_TMP1 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window1 Check_region [!!AREA(Check_window1)*AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)-(~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window1)))] > 0.7 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER DRC:1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window2 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP1) with width >= 200.0/4
    err1_TMP2 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window2 Check_region [!!AREA(Check_window2)*AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)-(~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window2)))] > 0.7 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window3 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP2) with width >= 200.0/4
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window3 Check_region [!!AREA(Check_window3)*AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)-(~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window3)))] > 0.7 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP2 BY POLYGON
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_GT_D_7a_Max.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_GT_D_7a_Max.rdb"
}

GT_D_7b_Min {
    @ Global GT density for fully chip (including dummy)>= 0.1
    @ <= 0.45
    Check_region = DRC:1 NOT EXCLUi
    Check_pattern = (GT_all NOT EXCLUi) AND Check_region
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_region [(!AREA(Check_pattern)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region))] < 0.1
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_GT_D_7b_Min.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_GT_D_7b_Min.rdb"
}

GT_D_7b_Max {
    @ Global GT density for fully chip (including dummy)>= 0.1
    @ <= 0.45
    Check_region = DRC:1 NOT EXCLUi
    Check_pattern = (GT_all NOT EXCLUi) AND Check_region
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_region [!!AREA(Check_pattern)*(AREA(Check_pattern))/AREA(Check_region)] > 0.45
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_GT_D_7b_Max.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_GT_D_7b_Max.rdb"
}

GT_D_7c {
    @ GT density inside of dummy block area (DUMBP OR NODMF), while the area of dummy block layer is larger than 2500um2 (50X50um).>= 0.1
    X = AREA (DUMBP OR NODMF) > 2500
    Check_region = X NOT EXCLUi
    Check_pattern = (GT_all NOT EXCLUi) AND Check_region
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_region [(!AREA(Check_pattern)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region))] < 0.1
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_GT_D_7c.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_GT_D_7c.rdb"
}

GT_R_8 {
    @ No bent GT on AA are allowed. All GT patterns on AA have to be orthogonal to AA edge.
    @ DRC waive check the INDMY and INST covered region, and waive check (AA AND GT) width <= 0.01um pattern.
    GTEIAA1 = GTEIAA COIN EDGE ((GT AND AA) WITH WIDTH > 0.01)
    ((INT GTEIAA1 < 0.01 ABUT == 90 REGION) NOT INSIDE (INDMY OR INST)) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    ((EXT GTEIAA1 < 0.01 ABUT == 90 REGION) NOT INSIDE (INDMY OR INST)) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    ((INT GTEIAA1 < 0.01 ABUT == 45 REGION) NOT INSIDE (INDMY OR INST)) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    ((EXT GTEIAA1 < 0.01 ABUT == 45 REGION) NOT INSIDE (INDMY OR INST)) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    ((INT GTEIAA1 < 0.01 ABUT == 135 REGION) NOT INSIDE (INDMY OR INST)) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    ((EXT GTEIAA1 < 0.01 ABUT == 135 REGION) NOT INSIDE (INDMY OR INST)) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    AAEIGT1 = AAEIGT COIN EDGE ((GT AND AA) WITH WIDTH > 0.01)
    ((INT GTEIAA1 AAEIGT1 < 0.01 ABUT != 90 REGION) NOT INSIDE (INDMY OR INST)) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

GT_EN_11 {
    @ GT is enclosed by SN and/or SP. except MOM and HRPDMY area (when checking the rule, size down the HRPDMY by 0.3um along the current direction)
    @ DRC waive check the INST covered region.
    HRPR = GT INTERACT HRPDMY
    HRP_END = SIZE (HRPR NOT HRPDMY) BY 0.3
    GT_MID = ( GT INTERACT (HRPDMY OR HRP)) NOT HRP_END
    Y = ((((GT INTERACT CT) NOT GT_MID) NOT SP) NOT SN) NOT INTERACT MOMDMY
    (Y NOT INSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

GT_S_16 {
    @ GATE space when L-shape AA and L-shape GT enclosed area is < 0.012 um2>= 0.15um
    X = AA_LS OR GT_LS
    Y = AREA (HOLES X INNER) < 0.012
    Z = GATE INTERACT Y SINGULAR ONLY
    ((EXT Z < 0.15 ABUT<90 REGION) INTERACT Y) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

GT_S_16a {
    @ GATE space when L-shape AA and L-shape GT enclosed area is < 0.012 um2>= 0.14um
    X = AA_LS OR GT_LS
    Y = AREA (HOLES X INNER) < 0.012
    Z = GATE INTERACT Y SINGULAR ONLY
    ((EXT Z < 0.14 ABUT<90 REGION) INTERACT Y) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

GT_S_17 {
    @ Space between large GT and GATE with narrow channel length<= 0.08 Âµm.
    @ The large GT definition:
    @ GT area >= 630 Âµm2 and within regions of density > 70% in window 30 Âµm x 30 Âµm, stepping 15 Âµm. Dummy poly isnât included in the density check.>= 1um
    Density_region = DENSITY GT > 0.7 WINDOW 30 STEP 15
    Large_GT = (AREA GT >= 630) INSIDE Density_region
    GATE_LE = (GATE TOUCH EDGE (INT GATE_W [GATE] < 0.005 ABUT INTERSECTING ONLY)) NOT COIN EDGE GATE_W
    GATE_check = GATE WITH EDGE (LENGTH GATE_LE <= 0.08)
    EXT Large_GT GATE_check < 1 ABUT<90 SINGULAR REGION
}

GT_S_18_R {
    @ Space between GT dense line end to line (Dh) or GT line to line (Ds) when:
    @ 1.Â  GT line end definition: GT width < 0.14Âµm
    @ 2.Â  Run length of GT line to line or GT line to end: E1 >= -0.03Âµm
    @ Any one edge distance from the corner of the two edges: K1 < 0.14Âµm
    @ Any one of Dh or Ds meet this rule value is ok.
    @ 3.Â  DRC waive check GT small extrusion F < 0.04Âµm and exclude SRAM region.>= 0.14um
    LINE_END = CONVEX EDGE GT ANGLE1 ==90 LENGTH1 >=0.04 ANGLE2 ==90 LENGTH2 >=0.04 WITH LENGTH < 0.14
    LINE_END_SHAPE1 = EXPAND EDGE LINE_END INSIDE BY 0.11
    LINE_SIDE1 = (GT COIN EDGE LINE_END_SHAPE1 ) NOT COIN EDGE LINE_END
    LINE_END_SHAPE = EXPAND EDGE LINE_END INSIDE BY 0.14
    LINE_SIDE = (GT COIN EDGE LINE_END_SHAPE ) NOT COIN EDGE LINE_END
    LINE_END_EXP = EXPAND EDGE LINE_END INSIDE BY 0.001 EXTEND BY 0.03
    LINE_SIDE_EXP = EXPAND EDGE LINE_SIDE1 INSIDE BY 0.001 EXTEND BY 0.03
    LINE_END_1 = LINE_END_EXP TOUCH EDGE LINE_END
    LINE_SIDE_1 = LINE_SIDE_EXP TOUCH EDGE LINE_SIDE
    E1 = EXT [LINE_END_1] GT < 0.14 OPPOSITE PERP ALSO OBTUSE ALSO
    E2 = EXT [LINE_SIDE] < 0.14 OPPOSITE
    LINE_END_E1 = LINE_END_1 TOUCH EDGE E1
    LINE_SIDE_E2 = LINE_SIDE_1 TOUCH EDGE E2
    GT_CORNER = INT LINE_END_E1 LINE_SIDE_E2 <= 0.002 ABUT == 90 REGION
    ((LINE_END_SHAPE INTERACT GT_CORNER) OUTSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

GT_L_19_G {
    @ GT length between two CTs without GATE, and the length from any point inside GATE to nearest CT, when the GT width is < 0.13um. This rule is for voltage drop concern. DRC waive check ESDIO1 or ESDMOS covered region.<= 25um
    GT_CHECK = ((WITH WIDTH GT < 0.13) NOT GATE) INTERACT CT
    Z0 = SIZE CT BY 12.5 INSIDE OF GT_CHECK STEP 0.02
    ((GT_CHECK INTERACT Z0 > 1) NOT INSIDE (ESDIO1 OR ESDMOS)) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    X = GATE WITH EDGE (LENGTH GATE_L < 0.13)
    Y = (GT INTERACT X) INTERACT CT
    Z = SIZE CT BY 25 INSIDE OF Y STEP 0.02
    (((GATE INTERACT Y) NOT INSIDE Z) NOT INSIDE (ESDIO1 OR ESDMOS)) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

GT_L_21 {
    @ H-shape GATE is forbidden when:
    @ 1.Â  GATE channel length is < 0.11um
    @ 2.Â  GT center bar length < 0.425um
    @ 3.Â Â  All four H-legs Length (X) >0.065um, and all four H-legs width (Y) <0.265um
    GT_CHECK = GT_HS INTERACT AA
    X1 = CONVEX EDGE GT_CHECK == 0
    Y1 = INT X1 < 0.11 REGION OPPOSITE
    Y11 = INT (Y1 INSIDE EDGE AA) < 0.11 REGION OPPOSITE
    X2 = LENGTH (Y1 TOUCH EDGE Y11) < 0.425
    Y2 = EXPAND EDGE X2 INSIDE BY 0.001
    X3 = CONVEX EDGE GT_CHECK == 1
    Y3 = GT_CHECK WITH EDGE (LENGTH X3 > 0.065) == 4
    X4 = CONVEX EDGE GT_CHECK == 2
    Y4 = INT X3 X4 < 0.265 REGION OPPOSITE
    ((((GT_CHECK INTERACT Y1) INTERACT Y2) INTERACT Y3) INTERACT Y4) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

SN_EX_6_8 {

}

SN_S_13 {
@ Butted P+ pick-up AA space to GT in the same AA (the butted N+ACTIVE extending <0.18um)>= 0.24um

  GTSN   = (GT WITH EDGE GTSN_1) TOUCH EDGE NGATE
  (EXT BUTSN_1 GTSN < 0.24 ABUT<90 REGION) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

SP_EX_6_8 {

SP_S_15 {

CT_R_1 {

}

CT_S_2b {

}

CT_S_2b1 {

CT_EN_5a_R {

M1_S_2b {

    span_edge = EXT [span_edge_1] M1ALL < 0.5 ABUT < 90 OPPOSITE
    (LENGTH span_edge >= 2) NOT INSIDE EDGE EXCLU
}

}

M3_S_11 {
    @ Space (S1 or S2) at Mn line-end (W<0.12um) in a dense-line-end configuration: If Mn has parallel run length with opposite Mn (measured with E1>=-0.035um extension) along 2 adjacent edges of Mn (any one edge distance from the corner of the two edges: K1<0.12um), then one of the space (S1 or S2) needs to be at least this value (except for small jog with edge length < 0.10um). DRC waive check the INST covered region.>= 0.12um
    LINE_END = CONVEX EDGE M3 ANGLE1 == 90 LENGTH1 >= 0.10 ANGLE2 == 90 LENGTH2 >= 0.10 WITH LENGTH < 0.12
    LINE_END_SHAPE = EXPAND EDGE LINE_END INSIDE BY 0.12
    LINE_SIDE = (M3 COIN EDGE LINE_END_SHAPE ) NOT COIN EDGE LINE_END
    LINE_END_EXP = EXPAND EDGE LINE_END INSIDE BY 0.001 EXTEND BY 0.035
    LINE_SIDE_EXP = EXPAND EDGE LINE_SIDE INSIDE BY 0.001 EXTEND BY 0.035
    LINE_END_1 = LINE_END_EXP TOUCH EDGE LINE_END
    LINE_SIDE_1 = LINE_SIDE_EXP TOUCH EDGE LINE_SIDE
    E1 = EXT [LINE_END_1] M3 < 0.12 OPPOSITE PERP ALSO OBTUSE ALSO
    E2 = EXT [LINE_SIDE] < 0.12 OPPOSITE
    LINE_END_E1 = LINE_END_1 TOUCH EDGE E1
    LINE_SIDE_E2 = LINE_SIDE_1 TOUCH EDGE E2
    M3_CORNER = INT LINE_END_E1 LINE_SIDE_E2 <= 0.002 ABUT == 90 REGION
    ((LINE_END_SHAPE INTERACT M3_CORNER) OUTSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

    LINE_SIDE_EXP = EXPAND EDGE LINE_SIDE INSIDE BY 0.001 EXTEND BY 0.035
    LINE_END_1 = LINE_END_EXP TOUCH EDGE LINE_END
    LINE_SIDE_1 = LINE_SIDE_EXP TOUCH EDGE LINE_SIDE
    E1 = EXT [LINE_END_1] M5 < 0.12 OPPOSITE PERP ALSO OBTUSE ALSO
    E2 = EXT [LINE_SIDE] < 0.12 OPPOSITE
    LINE_END_E1 = LINE_END_1 TOUCH EDGE E1
    LINE_SIDE_E2 = LINE_SIDE_1 TOUCH EDGE E2
    M5_CORNER = INT LINE_END_E1 LINE_SIDE_E2 <= 0.002 ABUT == 90 REGION

    Check_region = DRC:1 NOT (OR INDMY MARKG MARKS EXCLUi)
    Check_pattern = (M6ALL NOT (OR INDMY MARKG MARKS EXCLUi)) AND Check_region
    CHIP_wilayer = BULK INTERACT Check_pattern
    Check_window1 = Check_region with width >= 25.0/4
    err1_TMP1 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window1 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(25.0*25.0/4-AREA(Check_window1))+(!AREA(Check_window1)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.1 WINDOW 25.0 STEP 12.5 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER DRC:1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window2 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP1) with width >= 25.0/4
    err1_TMP2 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window2 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(25.0*25.0/4-AREA(Check_window2))+(!AREA(Check_window2)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.1 WINDOW 25.0 STEP 12.5 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window3 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP2) with width >= 25.0/4
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window3 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(25.0*25.0/4-AREA(Check_window3))+(!AREA(Check_window3)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.1 WINDOW 25.0 STEP 12.5 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP2 BY POLYGON
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_M6_D_6d.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_M6_D_6d.rdb"
}

M6_S_11 {
    @ Space (S1 or S2) at Mn line-end (W<0.12um) in a dense-line-end configuration: If Mn has parallel run length with opposite Mn (measured with E1>=-0.035um extension) along 2 adjacent edges of Mn (any one edge distance from the corner of the two edges: K1<0.12um), then one of the space (S1 or S2) needs to be at least this value (except for small jog with edge length < 0.10um). DRC waive check the INST covered region.>= 0.12um
    LINE_END = CONVEX EDGE M6 ANGLE1 == 90 LENGTH1 >= 0.10 ANGLE2 == 90 LENGTH2 >= 0.10 WITH LENGTH < 0.12
    LINE_END_SHAPE = EXPAND EDGE LINE_END INSIDE BY 0.12
    LINE_SIDE = (M6 COIN EDGE LINE_END_SHAPE ) NOT COIN EDGE LINE_END
    LINE_END_EXP = EXPAND EDGE LINE_END INSIDE BY 0.001 EXTEND BY 0.035
    LINE_SIDE_EXP = EXPAND EDGE LINE_SIDE INSIDE BY 0.001 EXTEND BY 0.035
    LINE_END_1 = LINE_END_EXP TOUCH EDGE LINE_END
    LINE_SIDE_1 = LINE_SIDE_EXP TOUCH EDGE LINE_SIDE
    E1 = EXT [LINE_END_1] M6 < 0.12 OPPOSITE PERP ALSO OBTUSE ALSO
    E2 = EXT [LINE_SIDE] < 0.12 OPPOSITE
    LINE_END_E1 = LINE_END_1 TOUCH EDGE E1
    LINE_SIDE_E2 = LINE_SIDE_1 TOUCH EDGE E2
    M6_CORNER = INT LINE_END_E1 LINE_SIDE_E2 <= 0.002 ABUT == 90 REGION
    ((LINE_END_SHAPE INTERACT M6_CORNER) OUTSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

V1_EN_3a_3b {
    @ V1_EN_3a: V1 must be fully enclosed by M1, except INST region.>= 0um
    @ V1_EN_3b: M1 enclosure of V1 when M1 enclosure on one or both perpendicular directions<0.03um, except INST region.>= 0.03um

    B = V1 COIN EDGE M1
    D2 = INT B < 0.005 ABUT==90 REGION
    (D2 NOT INSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    Y = ENC V1 M1 < 0.030 OPPOSITE REGION
    C1 = V1 COIN EDGE M1
    C2 = V1 COIN EDGE Y
    D3 = INT C1 C2 < 0.005 ABUT==90 REGION
    (D3 NOT INSIDE INST) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    (V1i NOT M1) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
    (V1 NOT INTERACT M1) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

}

TV2_EN_3a_3b {

TKM_D_7a {
    @ TKM density (including dummy) in 400umX400um window with step size 200um.<= 0.7
    Check_region = DRC:1 NOT EXCLUi
    Check_pattern = (TKMALL NOT EXCLUi) AND Check_region
    Check_window1 = Check_region with width >= 400.0/4
    err1_TMP1 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window1 Check_region [!!AREA(Check_window1)*AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)-(~~(400.0*400.0/4-AREA(Check_window1)))] > 0.7 WINDOW 400.0 STEP 200.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER DRC:1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window2 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP1) with width >= 400.0/4
    err1_TMP2 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window2 Check_region [!!AREA(Check_window2)*AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)-(~~(400.0*400.0/4-AREA(Check_window2)))] > 0.7 WINDOW 400.0 STEP 200.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window3 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP2) with width >= 400.0/4
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window3 Check_region [!!AREA(Check_window3)*AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)-(~~(400.0*400.0/4-AREA(Check_window3)))] > 0.7 WINDOW 400.0 STEP 200.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP2 BY POLYGON
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_TKM_D_7a.log"

}

RESNWST_S_6 {

RESNWST_O_7 {

 (RESNW_NWSTI AND VTPH) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
 (RESNW_NWSTI AND LVN) NOT INSIDE EXCLU

RESP1_R_1a_R {
@ Suggest the Nsq >= 1 for stable Resistivity>= 1
  X = RESP1 AND SAB
  Y = (GT AND RESP1) AND SAB
  L = (INSIDE EDGE GT X) OR EDGE (GT COIN EDGE X)
  W = INSIDE EDGE Y GT
  (DFM PROPERTY Y L W OVERLAP ABUT ALSO [SQUARES = LENGTH(L)/LENGTH(W)] < 1) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

RESP1_R_3 {
@ Dummy layer RESP1 is drawn to block LDD implant in the resistor area according to LOTA table.
  X = RESP1 INTERACT GTR_SA
  (AND NLL X) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND NLH X) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND PLL X) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (AND PLH X) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

RESP1_EN_10 {
@ Enclosure of SP/SN outside of a Poly resistor area (following GT.EX.9 rule)>= 0.16um
@ Note:
@ RESP1.n(n=1 â 6, 8,9) is for non-silicide poly resistor, RESP1.R.7 is for silicide poly resistor.
  X = RESP1 AND GT
  (ENC X SN < 0.16 ABUT < 90 SINGULAR REGION) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (ENC X SP < 0.16 ABUT < 90 SINGULAR REGION) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

HRP_R_3_R {
    @ It is strongly suggested that the resistor square number (length/width ratio) >=5 for precise Rs.>= 5
    X = HRPDMY INTERACT SAB
    Y = X INTERACT HRP
    Z = (GT AND HRPDMY) AND SAB
    L = (INSIDE EDGE GT Y) OR EDGE (GT COIN EDGE Y)
    W = INSIDE EDGE Z GT
    (DFM PROPERTY Z L W OVERLAP ABUT ALSO [SQUARES = LENGTH(L)/LENGTH(W)] < 5) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

HRP_O_7 {
@ SP overlap with SAB = 0.3um
  SP_HRP = SP INTERACT HRP
  SAB_HRP = SAB INTERACT HRP
  X = SP_HRP AND SAB_HRP
  (INT X < 0.30 ABUT<90 SINGULAR REGION) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (SIZE X BY 0.15 UNDEROVER) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

HRP_O_7a {
@ SP overlap with SAB = 0.2um
  SP_HRP = SP INTERACT HRP
  SAB_HRP = SAB INTERACT HRP
  X = SP_HRP AND SAB_HRP
  (INT X < 0.20 ABUT<90 SINGULAR REGION) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
  (SIZE X BY 0.1 UNDEROVER) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

HRP_R_11 {
@ (SN, SP) layers are not allowed in the HRPDMY region (when checking the rule, size down the HRPDMY by 0.3um along the current direction).
 HRPR    = GT INTERACT HRP
 HRP_END = SIZE (HRPR NOT HRPDMY) BY 0.3
 HRP_MID = HRPR NOT HRP_END
 ((SN OR SP) AND HRP_MID) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

SL_D_7_M1_G {
    @ Slot density of wide metal when>= 0.1
    @ 1.Â  Metal width > 12um for inter-metal, Metal width > 20um for TM1, Metal width > 30um for TM2. Metal width >50um for TKM. DRC checks the metal main pattern (M1, M2â¦), not following (Mn-MnSLOT).
    @ 2.Â  The wide metal interacts with metal slot (M1SLOT, M2SLOTâ¦).
    @ 3.Â  Metal slot (M1SLOT, M2SLOTâ¦) size > 10*10 um are not included this rule density calculation.
    @ 4.Â  DRC doesnât check metals interact with RV.
    @ 5.Â  DRC individually exports result by each metal layer.
    X_M1 = ((M1i NOT INTERACT RV) WITH WIDTH > 12) INTERACT M1SLOT
    Y_M1 = (M1SLOT WITH WIDTH <=10) NOT INTERACT RV
    Z_M1 = DFM PROPERTY X_M1 Y_M1 OVERLAP [- = AREA(Y_M1)/AREA(X_M1)] < 0.1
    DFM RDB Z_M1 "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_SL_D_7_M1_G.log"
    (DFM COPY Z_M1) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

ESD_W_3_G {
@ ESD.3(G) is defined for total channel width of ESD N/PMOS. The total channel width is calculated by the ESD MOS in the same Drain connection. The connectivity can be formed by all metal, via, ALPA, RV and PA but not broken by resistors. SAB is used for drain recognition in DRC runset.
@ Channel width (W) of NMOS and PMOS for ESD protection device (Channel width=Finger width x Finger No.)>= 360um
X = NET AREA RATIO ENGATE_D_EMPTY ESD3C_EMPTY [AREA(ESD3C_EMPTY)/0.001] < 360
Y = NET AREA RATIO EPGATE_D_EMPTY ESD3C_EMPTY [AREA(ESD3C_EMPTY)/0.001] < 360
((X INTERACT ENGATE) NOT INTERACT EGATE_NOSAB) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
((Y INTERACT EPGATE) NOT INTERACT EGATE_NOSAB) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

ESD_R_11_G {
@ ESD protection devices should be surrounded by guard ring, this guard ring also can be designed as the pickup of the ESD device. (Fig.2)
ENGUARDRING = HOLES ENTAP INNER EMPTY
EPGUARDRING = HOLES EPTAP INNER EMPTY
(EPMOS NOT ENGUARDRING) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
(EPMOS NOT EPGUARDRING) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
(ENMOS NOT EPGUARDRING) NOT INSIDE EXCLU
}

ESD_R_11a_G {
@ Space between N+AA and P+AA for 1.2V/2.5V/2.5V overdrive 3.3V ESD PMOS. (BS)>= 2.1um
CHECK_REGION = (OR 1_2V_ESD_MOS 2_5V_ESD_MOS ESD_2_5V_O_3_3V)INTERACT EPGATE
EPACT_BS = (EPACT INTERACT EGATE)AND CHECK_REGION
ENACT_BS = (DONUT(ENACT AND CHECK_REGION))NOT INTERACT EGATE
(EXT ENACT_BS EPACT_BS < 2.1 ABUT < 90 SINGULAR REGION)NOT EXCLU
}

ESD_R_11b_G {
@ Space between N+AA and P+AA for 1.2V/2.5V/2.5V overdrive 3.3V ESD PMOS.(PS)>= 2um
CHECK_REGION = (OR 1_2V_ESD_MOS 2_5V_ESD_MOS ESD_2_5V_O_3_3V)INTERACT EPGATE
ENACT_PS = (DONUT(ENACT AND CHECK_REGION))NOT INTERACT EGATE
EPACT_PS = (DONUT(EPACT AND CHECK_REGION))NOT INTERACT EGATE
((EXT ENACT_PS EPACT_PS < 2 ABUT < 90 SINGULAR REGION) AND CHECK_REGION)NOT EXCLU
}

ESD_R_11c_G {
@ Space between N+AA and P+AA for 1.2V/2.5V/2.5V overdrive 3.3V/ 1.2V Cascoded ESD NMOS. (PS)>= 2.1um
CHECK_REGION = (OR 1_2V_ESD_MOS 2_5V_ESD_MOS ESD_2_5V_O_3_3V 1_2V_ESD_CASCODED)INTERACT ENGATE
ENACT_PS = (ENACT INTERACT EGATE)AND CHECK_REGION
EPACT_PS = (DONUT(EPACT AND CHECK_REGION))NOT INTERACT EGATE
((EXT ENACT_PS EPACT_PS < 2.1 ABUT < 90 SINGULAR REGION) AND CHECK_REGION)NOT EXCLU
}

ESD_O_13_G {
@ SAB should cover all top poly gates and extend to overlap the second poly gate (active poly gate) of 1.2V Cascoded NMOS.(SOL) (Fig.6) >= 0.02um
ESAB_CASCODED = ESAB AND 1_2V_ESD_CASCODED
(EGATE_1_2V_CASCODED NOT INTERACT ESAB)NOT EXCLU
(ESAB_CASCODED TOUCH EGATE_1_2V_CASCODED )NOT EXCLU
(ESAB_CASCODED INTERACT EGATE_1_2V_CASCODED !=4)NOT EXCLU
(INT ESAB_CASCODED EGATE_1_2V_CASCODED < 0.02 ABUT < 90 SINGULAR REGION)NOT EXCLU
}

ESD_L_22_G {

@ <= 2um
(WITH WIDTH ESDNDIO_FINGER < 0.5)NOT EXCLU
(WITH WIDTH ESDNDIO_FINGER > 2)NOT EXCLU
(WITH WIDTH ESDPDIO_FINGER < 0.5)NOT EXCLU
(WITH WIDTH ESDPDIO_FINGER > 2)NOT EXCLU
}

ESD_W_23_G {

@ <= 60um	
(RECTANGLE ESDNDIO_FINGER >= 0.5 <= 2 BY < 20)NOT EXCLU
(RECTANGLE ESDNDIO_FINGER >= 0.5 <= 2 BY > 60)NOT EXCLU
(RECTANGLE ESDPDIO_FINGER >= 0.5 <= 2 BY < 20)NOT EXCLU
(RECTANGLE ESDPDIO_FINGER >= 0.5 <= 2 BY > 60)NOT EXCLU
}

ESD_S_25_G {
@ The AA spacing between (N+AA AND PW)/(P+AA AND NW) and P+ pickup AA/N+ pickup AA ring (S1/S2) (Fig.1a). >= 0.5um
@ <= 1um
(EXT ESDDIO_NTAP_RING ESDPDIO_FINGER < 0.5 ABUT < 90 SINGULAR REGION)NOT EXCLU
(EXT ESDDIO_PTAP_RING ESDNDIO_FINGER < 0.5 ABUT < 90 SINGULAR REGION)NOT EXCLU
((SIZE ESDPDIO_FINGER BY 1)INSIDE EDGE ESDDIO_NTAP_HOLE)NOT INSIDE EDGE EXCLU
((SIZE ESDNDIO_FINGER BY 1)INSIDE EDGE ESDDIO_PTAP_HOLE)NOT INSIDE EDGE EXCLU
}

LU_S_4_NTAP_G {
    @ Maximum space (S2) from any point within the Source/Drain region to the nearest pickup AA region inside the same well for I/O and internal circuits. (Fig. 7.3.10-2)
    @ For native device, DRC check the pickup AA inside the PSUB butted PW area, and PW is still treated as connection by substrate even one NW ring inserted.<= 35 Âµm
    A = INT NTAP < 0.005 ABUT INTERSECTING ONLY REGION
    B = (NTAP INTERACT A) NOT A
    C = INT B < 0.001 ABUT INTERSECTING ONLY REGION
    D = (B INTERACT C) NOT C
    NW_MINUS_NTAP_0 = SIZE D BY 15 INSIDE OF NW STEP 0.38 TRUNCATE 0.1
    MAYBE_BAD_b = NW NOT NW_MINUS_NTAP_0
    NW_FILTER = NW INTERACT MAYBE_BAD_b
    NW_MINUS_NTAP_1 = NW_MINUS_NTAP_0 AND NW_FILTER
    NW_MINUS_NTAP = SIZE NW_MINUS_NTAP_1 BY 20 INSIDE OF NW_FILTER STEP 0.38 TRUNCATE 0.1
    X = PMOS1 AND NW_FILTER
    (OUTSIDE EDGE X NW_MINUS_NTAP) NOT INSIDE EDGE EXCLU
}

LU_S_4_PTAP_G {

    C = INT B < 0.001 ABUT INTERSECTING ONLY REGION
    D = (B INTERACT C) NOT C
    PW_MINUS_PTAP_0 = SIZE D BY 15 INSIDE OF PW STEP 0.38 TRUNCATE 0.1
    MAYBE_BAD_b = PW NOT PW_MINUS_PTAP_0
    PW_FILTER = PW INTERACT MAYBE_BAD_b
    PW_MINUS_PTAP_1 = PW_MINUS_PTAP_0 AND PW_FILTER
    PW_MINUS_PTAP = SIZE PW_MINUS_PTAP_1 BY 20 INSIDE OF PW_FILTER STEP 0.38 TRUNCATE 0.1
    X = NMOS1 AND PW_FILTER
    (OUTSIDE EDGE X PW_MINUS_PTAP) NOT INSIDE EDGE EXCLU
}

DFM_D_19_Min {
    @ Local AA density (including dummy): Density check window size 200um*200um, step size: 100um>= 0.3
    @ <= 0.7
    Check_region = DRC:1 NOT (OR EXDFMi EXCLUi)
    Check_pattern = (AA_all NOT (OR EXDFMi EXCLUi)) AND Check_region
    CHIP_wilayer = BULK INTERACT Check_pattern
    Check_window1 = Check_region with width >= 200.0/4
    err1_TMP1 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window1 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window1))+(!AREA(Check_window1)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.3 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER DRC:1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window2 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP1) with width >= 200.0/4
    err1_TMP2 = DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window2 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window2))+(!AREA(Check_window2)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.3 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP1 BY POLYGON
    Check_window3 = (Check_region AND err1_TMP2) with width >= 200.0/4
    DENSITY Check_pattern Check_window3 Check_region CHIP_wilayer [~~(200.0*200.0/4-AREA(Check_window3))+(!AREA(Check_window3)+(!AREA(CHIP_wilayer)+AREA(Check_pattern)/AREA(Check_region)))] < 0.3 WINDOW 200.0 STEP 100.0 BACKUP INSIDE OF LAYER err1_TMP2 BY POLYGON
    PRINT "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_DFM_D_19_Min.log"
    RDB "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_DFM_D_19_Min.rdb"
}

DFM_R_18 {
@ M1 horse shoe space A and C, when B>=0.12 um (See attached picture)>= 0.12
   A = CONVEX EDGE M1 ANGLE1 == 90 ANGLE2 == 90 LENGTH1 > 0.12 LENGTH2 > 0.21 WITH LENGTH >= 0.12 < 0.20
   B = INNERCORNER WITH EDGE A
   B_edge = B COIN EDGE M1
   C = M1 TOUCH EDGE B_edge
   C1 = EXPAND EDGE C INSIDE BY 0.001
   C2 = C1 INTERACT INNERCORNER >= 2 <= 3
   C3 = C2 TOUCH OUTERCORNER >= 1 <= 2
   C3_edge = C3 COIN EDGE M1
   C4 = A TOUCH EDGE C3_edge
   C5 = EXPAND EDGE C4 INSIDE BY 0.001
   D  = CONVEX EDGE M1 ANGLE1 == 270 ANGLE2 == 270 LENGTH1 > 0.12 LENGTH2 > 0.12 WITH LENGTH >= 0.12
   D1 = OUTERCORNER WITH EDGE D
   D1_edge = D1 COIN EDGE M1
   D2 = M1 TOUCH EDGE D1_edge
   D3 = EXPAND EDGE D2 OUTSIDE BY 0.001
   D4 = D3 INTERACT OUTERCORNER == 2
   D5 = D4 TOUCH INNERCORNER == 2
   E1 = C5 TOUCH D5
   E2 = E1 OR D5
   E2_edge = E2 COIN EDGE M1
   E = M1 TOUCH EDGE E2
  (EXT E (M1 TOUCH EDGE B_edge)< 0.12 OPPOSITE REGION) NOT INSIDE EXDFM
}

DFM_EX_44 {

  MOS_AA_V = AA ENCLOSE GATE_VTNH4_B_H

DFM_D_102_M1 {
    @ Slot density of wide metal when:
    @ 1.Â  Metal width > 12um for inter-metal, Metal width > 20um for TM1, Metal width > 30um for TM2. Metal width >50um for TKM. DRC checks the metal main pattern (M1, M2...), not following (Mn-MnSLOT)
    @ 2.Â  The wide metal interacts with metal slot (M1SLOT, M2SLOT...)
    @ 3.Â  Metal slot (M1SLOT, M2SLOT...) size > 10*10 um are not included this rule density calculation
    @ 4.Â  DRC doesnât check metals interact with RV
    @ 5.Â  DRC individually exports result by each metal layer>= 0.15
    X_M1 = ((M1i NOT INTERACT RV) WITH WIDTH > 12) INTERACT M1SLOT
    Y_M1 = (M1SLOT WITH WIDTH <=10) NOT INTERACT RV
    Z_M1 = DFM PROPERTY X_M1 Y_M1 OVERLAP [- = AREA(Y_M1)/AREA(X_M1)] < 0.15
    DFM RDB Z_M1 "./Process_CALDRC_logfile/density_report_DFM_D_102_M1.log"
    (DFM COPY Z_M1) NOT INSIDE EXDFM
}
